title: Toddler formula, store brand, pediatric shake

content.title: About
content.content: The "Store Brand Pediatric Shake" toddler formula is designed for children aged 1 to 3 years. It is enriched with vitamins, minerals, and proteins essential for growth and development. The formula is produced under strict quality standards and is safe for daily consumption.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Developed in collaboration with pediatricians to provide a complete nutrient profile.
Contains DHA and ARA – fatty acids important for brain and eye development.
Free from artificial colors and flavors.
Each serving provides 20 % of the daily iron requirement, helping prevent anemia.
Packaged for 30 servings, convenient for refrigerator storage.

items.title: Supports bone growth
items.content: Includes calcium and vitamin D, which promote strong bone formation.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA support neural connections and visual function.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamins A, C and zinc help maintain the body’s defense mechanisms.

items.title: Energy provision
items.content: Lactose and complex carbohydrates provide a steady energy supply throughout the day.

items.title: Digestive health
items.content: Probiotics in the formula support a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The product contains milk protein; consult a physician if an allergy is suspected.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Children with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort; consider a lactose‑free alternative.

items.title: Iron content
items.content: Excessive iron intake can cause constipation; follow the recommended dosage.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Mix one serving (30 g) with 150 ml of warm (not hot) water or breast milk. Stir thoroughly until smooth. The product is typically offered 2–3 times daily according to the child’s needs.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and use within 30 days. Discard if the packaging is damaged or the product has an off‑odor.
